versions.name: Render env file from a dotenv template
versions.description: Expand a dotenv-style template (env.example) into an env file, substituting ${secrets.NAME} placeholders from explicit `with:` values. Replaces the kernel `config.render` block with a plugin step: secrets are declared where they are used (GHA-style), masked in logs, and the substitution happens where the file lives. Fail/warn/blank missing policies, output mode, and backup rotation match the kernel behavior. Dual engine: shell renders inside the job workspace; engine: ssh (set `host:`) renders into an absolute directory on each target host. Requires bash where it runs. Values must be single-line (double-quoted values keep their inner text verbatim).
versions.description_zh: 将 dotenv 风格模板（env.example）展开为 env 文件——从显式 `with:` 值替换 ${secrets.NAME} 占位符。以插件步骤替代内核 `config.render` 块：secret 在使用处声明（GHA 风格）、日志自动脱敏、替换发生在文件所在之处。缺失策略 fail/warn/blank、输出权限与备份轮换与内核行为一致。双引擎：shell 在任务工作区内渲染；engine: ssh（设置 `host:`）在目标主机的绝对目录内渲染。运行处需要 bash。值需为单行（双引号包裹的值内部原样保留）。
